openwrt_git_ar71xx.titel: ar71xx: add support for OCEDO Koala
openwrt_git_ar71xx.Serial: Header Next to Black metal shield. Pinout is 3.3V - GND - TX - RX (Arrow Pad is 3.3V). The Serial setting is 115200-8-N-1.
openwrt_git_ar71xx.Tested and working: Ethernet, 2.4 GHz WiFi, 5 GHz WiFi, TFTP boot from ramdisk image, Installation via ramdisk image, OpenWRT sysupgrade, Buttons, LEDs
openwrt_git_ar71xx.Installation: Installation seems to be possible only through booting an OpenWRT ramdisk image. Hold down the reset button while powering on the device. It will load a ramdisk image named 'koala-uImage-initramfs-lzma.bin' from 192.168.100.8. Note: depending on the present software, the device might also try to pull a file called 'koala-uimage-factory'. Only the name differs, it is still used as a ramdisk image.
openwrt_git_ar71xx.Bootloader: Due to the flip-flop bootloader which we not (yet) support, you need to set the partition the bootloader is selecting. It is possible from the initramfs image with > fw_setenv bootcmd run bootcmd_1

openwrt_git_ath79.text: Commit-Text identisch mit ar71xx-Commit e36f8b3f (SOC, RAM, FLASH, WLAN, LED, Serial, Installation, Flip-Flop-Bootloader)

openwrt_git_eth_fix.titel: ath79: fix OCEDO Koala ethernet configuration
openwrt_git_eth_fix.text: The OCEDO Koala has incorrect PLL settings which result in ~3% packet loss on ethernet connections. Also omit the gmac-configuration as it's incorrect too.

openwrt_git_ar71xx_dynpart.titel: ar71xx: move OCEDO Koala to generic and use dynamic partitioning
openwrt_git_ar71xx_dynpart.text: This changes the OCEDO Koala flash-layout to a unified firmware partition, thus making the ar71xx-generic kernel fit in flash.
